name: Ayushi Gangwar
about: Ayushi has expertise in clinical nutrition, personalized diet planning, and therapeutic nutrition counseling. She provides practical, evidence-based dietary guidance to help patients improve their health, drawing from her experience at Chandan Hospital.

name: Shikha Sharma
about: Shikha Sharma is a clinical nutritionist with experience in hospital settings. She specializes in creating balanced, personalized diet plans tailored to both vegetarian and non-vegetarian lifestyles to support overall health and clinical recovery.

name: Dr. Ujjwal Kumar
about: Dr. Ujjwal Kumar is a dedicated and compassionate healthcare professional. With clinical experience as a Duty Medical Officer and a background in homeopathic medicine, he is committed to providing holistic healthcare solutions and comprehensive patient care.

name: Dr. Ritwika Saha
about: Dr. Ritwika Saha is a highly experienced physician with over 7 years of clinical practice across top-tier institutions like Apollo, Manipal, and Woodlands Hospitals. She is known for her strong communication skills and dedication to serving patients.

name: Dr. Souvik Mahapatra
about: Dr. Souvik Mahapatra is a dedicated medical professional currently practicing at CMRI. He focuses on thorough patient counseling and continuously advancing his clinical knowledge to provide excellent outpatient care.

name: Dr. Shalini Arya
about: Dr. Shalini Arya is a highly skilled physiotherapist with over 8 years of experience, including tenure at the prestigious Bombay Hospital and Research Centre. She specializes in advanced treatments for both orthopedic and neurological conditions.
